title: speedgun-ng execution graph
description: The document the operator writes for one execution graph, the input of `--graph` (specs/037-execution-graphs FR-007, FR-008, contracts/graph-file.md). Key order is normative and stands in x-order: the top level names `nodes`, and one node names `name`, `slot` and `deps`. The harness checker reads this file and compares the key set, the key order and the value kinds of every graph file against it, the standing checker of specs/026 D-14. One node names itself with `name`, carries one context slot counted from `0` as `slot`, and lists its dependencies as node names in `deps`; an empty list stands for a source node. The file carries no benchmark name, no preset, no cpu index and no timing figure, and the schema admits no key beside the four (FR-008).
